incident_description:
Impact Summary

Between 29 June 2026 21:22 UTC and 29 June 2026 22:19 UTC, customers using Databricks Apps in AWS US East (N. Virginia) may have been unable to create, deploy, stop, or delete apps.

Symptoms

Customers may have experienced:
- App creation, deployment, stop, and deletion operations failing or returning errors
- App management operations not completing through the Workspace UI or Databricks APIs

Current Status

This incident has been fully resolved as of 29 June 2026 22:19 UTC. We apologize for the disruption. If you require further details about this incident, please submit a support ticket or contact help@databricks.com.

incident_name: US East 1 - Unity Catalog (Partial Service Disruption)
incident_description:
Impact Summary
Between 2026-06-08 15:55 UTC and 2026-06-08 16:35 UTC, customers using Unity Catalog in the AWS US East (N. Virginia) region experienced failures and delays when accessing governed data, metadata, and System Tables.

Symptoms
Customers experienced:
- Errors or failures when accessing Unity Catalog-governed data and metadata
- Failed or delayed requests to read or query System Tables (Audit Logs, Billable Usage, Lineage)
- Intermittent failures performing catalog and governance operations

Current Status
This incident has been fully resolved as of 2026-06-08 16:35 UTC, and Unity Catalog is operating normally. We apologize for the disruption. If you require further details about this incident, please submit a support ticket or contact help@databricks.com.

Next Update
No further updates are planned for this incident.
